title: Golf Simulator & Rooftop Hot Tub | Skyline Views
description:
Fully furnished 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom end-unit townhome in Nashville's up-and-coming Riverside North neighborhood comes with a private golf simulator in the garage and a rooftop hot tub with unobstructed Nashville skyline views. Whether you're planning a golf buddies trip, a bachelor/bachelorette weekend, or a group getaway that wants more than just a bed to sleep in, this home delivers a genuine "wow" the moment guests arrive.
